title: Make it impossible to manually re-order icons when not in manual positioning mode
line: Dragging an icon around a desktop sorted by name, size, type or date no longer switches it to Unsorted; the icon goes back to its sorted place.
explanation: When an icon was dropped onto an empty spot of its own Folder View, FolderModel::drop() called setUnsortedModeOnDrop(), which silently switched the sort mode to Unsorted (and deleted the saved manual layout) so the positioner could place the icon there. Moving a file between two screens' desktops did the same. The internal drop on empty space is now ignored while a sort mode is active, so the icon snaps back to its sorted place; moves between screens still work but land at the target's sorted position. The now unused setUnsortedModeOnDrop()/unsortedModeOnDrop() code in FolderModel and Positioner is removed.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Don't reorder icons by dragging in sorted mode

Dropping an icon onto an empty spot of a sorted desktop silently
switched the sort mode to Unsorted, throwing away the order the user had
picked. Sort modes now stay as they are and the icon goes back in place.

BUG: 413499
